items.t: Oil pump belt failure and engine damage (recall)
items.job: Replace oil pump belt and tensioner (recall); engine replacement if it has failed
items.note: Free under recall 23V905. Owners outside the recall or with other damage report that an engine is a very expensive repair.

items.t: Front axle shafts can pull out of the transmission (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Automatic transmission shudder, jerks or harsh shifts
items.job: Transmission diagnosis, fluid service, torque converter or transmission replacement
items.note: Low end is diagnosis and a fluid service; high end is a used or rebuilt transmission.

items.t: Coolant loss, white exhaust smoke and rough running (1.0L)
items.job: Cooling system diagnosis and cylinder head or engine repair
items.note: Depends on whether the head or block is damaged. A small leak may only need a hose or gasket.

items.t: Coolant leak from water pump or hoses
items.job: Replace water pump or coolant hose and refill coolant
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $565-$800 for a water pump.

items.t: Turbocharger failure (1.0L)
items.job: Replace turbocharger

items.t: Hard starting after filling the gas tank
items.job: Replace EVAP purge valve

items.t: Dead battery or charging system warning
items.job: Replace 12V battery or alternator
items.note: A battery alone is the low end; an alternator is the high end.

items.t: Backup camera blank or stays on (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Front seat frame may not be welded properly (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Front airbag may not inflate in a crash (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Ford dealer

items.t: Check engine light from crankcase ventilation codes (1.0L)
items.job: Diagnose and repair crankcase ventilation hose or pressure sensor

items.t: Check engine light from damaged wiring harness (2.0L)
items.job: Diagnose and repair engine wiring harness

items.t: Check engine light in freezing weather, code P0125 (2.0L)
items.job: Apply Ford bulletin repair for code P0125
items.note: May be covered if the vehicle is still under warranty.

items.t: Clicking or ratcheting from the driveshaft when backing up (AWD)
items.job: Driveshaft bulletin repair

items.t: Weak air conditioning
items.job: A/C diagnosis and recharge, or compressor control valve or compressor repair
items.note: RepairPal lists A/C evaporator replacement at about $1,778-$2,342, the worst case.

items.t: SYNC 3 screen freezes, goes black or will not respond
items.job: SYNC 3 software update
items.note: Owners can often install the update themselves for free.

items.t: Power windows stop working
items.job: Window module reprogramming or window motor/regulator replacement

items.t: Will not start with a Key Not Detected message
items.job: Apply keyless start bulletin fix

items.t: Radio switches from FM to AM by itself
items.job: Radio software update

items.t: Doors do not lock automatically
items.job: Reprogram body control module

items.t: Alarm goes off after a loud noise
items.job: Alarm bulletin repair

items.t: Exhaust system rusting early
items.job: Replace rusted exhaust pipe or muffler section
items.note: CarComplaints owners report an average of about $2,300 when the whole system is replaced.

items.t: Wrench light from remote start
items.job: Remote start bulletin repair
